spec.name: Alebrije Jaguar-Eagle
spec.description: A standing Oaxacan alebrije chimera: a jaguar's body on four short legs, an eagle head with a hooked golden beak and feather crest, half-spread patterned wings and a curling feathered tail, painted in saturated colors with dense dot and chevron motifs.
spec.layout: A quadruped standing on four short jaguar legs (the only parts touching the floor), body from chest z=+1.0 to rump z=-1.45 at hip height ~1.0. The eagle head rides a raised neck at the front: skull top ~2.3, hooked golden beak pointing +Z to z=2.25, tall feather crest sweeping back. Both wings spring from shoulder mounts at [±0.55, 1.9, 0.7] and spread outward and up to tips at [±2.2, 2.95, 0.1] — the widest part of the silhouette. The tail leaves the rump at [0, 1.5, -1.5] and curls up and back to [0, 2.55, -2.6], ending in a feather fan. From the front you read the cream chest bib, the striped face with round eyes and hook beak, wings arcing overhead. Every part wears the alebrije style: a saturated main coat, then motifs built as their own small seated parts — rows of painted dots, thin chevron slabs, zigzag trim bands between colors, golden claws and beak, inked pupils. Faceted primitive shapes, bold proportions, no real wood visible: it is wood as a painting.

parts.builds: The jaguar body, built skeleton-first on core, chest and hips: one smooth loft/sweep from the chest front (z≈+1.0, meeting the neckBase mount) over a deep chest, a tucked waist and a rounded rump to z≈-1.45 (the tailRoot mount), belly bottom near y≈0.85. Main coat orange; a cream chest bib wraps the front and the underside of the rump is cream — colour by place, warm top, pale belly. Alebrije patterning is built as its own small seated parts, not painted bands: two flanking rows of flattened disc dots (teal, magenta, green, red) marching down each side from shoulder to haunch; thin teal and cobalt chevron slabs laid over each shoulder blade and haunch like painted arrows; a golden spine ridge of small triangular spikes riding the back from chest to rump; a cream zigzag trim row separating orange back from cream belly (short slanted slabs in a repeating rhythm). Small feather tufts (magenta and teal spikes or cards) sprout at each shoulder where the wing mounts sit. Include the rounded shoulder hump just behind the neck. Ends: chest front reaches the neckBase mount at [0, 1.8, 1.05]; rump reaches the tailRoot mount at [0, 1.5, -1.5]; underside meets the four hip socket mounts.
parts.attaches: Front face of the chest builds up to the neckBase mount (the head part's neck overlaps it). Rump builds to the tailRoot mount. Underside meets hip mounts hipFL/hipFR/hipBL/hipBR — the legs part grows out of these sockets. Shoulders carry wingLRoot and wingRRoot mounts; leave the mount points free of geometry so the wings root into them.

parts.builds: Neck plus eagle head, the face settled first. Neck: a sweep rising from the neckBase mount [0, 1.8, 1.05] up to the head joint [0, 2.25, 1.55], orange with a cream throat bib and a row of teal dots down its front; two magenta side-feather fans where it meets the chest. Head: a rounded faceted skull (sphere/box blend) wider at the cheek ruffs, orange with a cream face mask around the eyes and beak. Beak as two separate jaws so it can open: an upper jaw riding the head joint — a golden hooked lathe/cone beak with a deepPurple tip and a thin cream cere band at the base, top edge to z≈2.25; and a lower jaw riding the jaw joint at the jawHinge mount [0, 2.12, 1.6] — a smaller cream mandible with a red tongue plate inside. Eyes: two big round eyes (spheres) at the head's face, white sclera, ink pupil, golden iris ring, each set inside a teal eyelid ring, with a bold deepPurple brow slab above each eye — the eyes must read from the front, nothing in front of them. Crest: three tall back-swept feather blades (extruded slabs, root to tip in magenta, teal, golden) rising from the crown to y≈2.75, plus two smaller green cheek feathers. Cheek ruffs: zigzag-edged cream feather plates (stepped slabs) flanking each eye. Chin wattle: a small coral teardrop under the beak. Finish with teal dot dots across the skull crown and a red chevron on each cheek.
parts.attaches: Neck base overlaps the torso's chest at the neckBase mount [0, 1.8, 1.05]; head and jaw ride the head and jaw joints; the jaw pivots at the jawHinge mount [0, 2.12, 1.6]. Crest and ruffs sit on the head bone only.

parts.builds: Both eagle wings, mirrored, riding the wingL and wingR joints, raised in a proud half-spread. Each wing: an arm bone sweep from its shoulder mount [±0.55, 1.9, 0.7] outward and up, bending at a wrist partway out toward [±1.5, 2.55, 0.3], carrying three finger prongs to the tip at [±2.2, 2.95, 0.1]; the arm is orange with a golden shoulder pauldron (a turned dome with a small red emblem dot) at the root and teal cuff bands at the wrist. Feather construction in bold layers, root to tip: two rows of broad covert feathers as extruded blades shingled down the arm — inner row cream, outer row teal; a mid row of long secondary feathers in cobalt and skyBlue alternating; primaries at the wing tip — five long separated blades in magenta, red, coral and deepPurple, each with a cream scallop tip and splayed apart. Wing underside gets a thin cream membrane or under-coverts in pink. Motifs: a single row of green and golden dots along the arm's top edge, a red chevron slab at the wrist, small white dots scattered on the cobalt secondaries. Keep the two wings identical with mirrored placement; tips reach [±2.2, 2.95, 0.1] and never touch the floor.
parts.attaches: Each wing's arm roots into its shoulder mount wingLRoot [0.55, 1.9, 0.7] / wingRRoot [-0.55, 1.9, 0.7], buried slightly into the torso's shoulder hump; rides the wingL and wingR joints.

parts.builds: Four muscular short jaguar legs, the only floor contact, riding the hip/knee/ankle joints of each leg. Each leg: a thick thigh sweep from its hip mount bulging backward, an angled shank to the knee and a lower shank down to the ankle; front legs straighter under the chest, back legs with heavier haunches. Coat orange with cream paws and lower shanks; patterning continuing the body language: teal chevron slabs across each thigh, magenta dot dots down the outer face of each shank, a red band above each ankle. Paws: chunky rounded boxes resting on y=0 (each paw's lowest points touch the floor), four golden claws each curling from the toe front, and a magenta paw pad plate on the sole. Ankle: a teal cuff band with golden dot studs. Paws of the front legs at z≈0.72, back legs at z≈-1.02; keep x within ±0.85 so the stance reads solid and symmetrical.
parts.attaches: Each leg's thigh grows out of its hip mount (hipFL [0.45, 0.98, 0.72], hipFR [-0.45, 0.98, 0.72], hipBL [0.48, 1.0, -1.0], hipBR [-0.48, 1.0, -1.0]) and rides that leg's hip, knee and ankle joints; paws touch the floor at y=0.

parts.builds: A serpentine feathered tail, the signature flourish, riding the tail and tailTip joints. A tapering sweep (radius from ~0.14 to a point) leaves the tailRoot mount [0, 1.5, -1.5], drops slightly then curls up and back through the tail joint to the tailTip joint at [0, 2.3, -2.35], ending at [0, 2.55, -2.6]. The tail is banded by alternating colours along its length — orange, teal, cobalt, magenta — each band edge trimmed with a thin cream ring; a dorsal ridge of small golden spikes rides the tail's top from root to mid. At the tip: a feather fan tuft — seven broad extruded blades fanning up and outward in green, coral, pink, golden and deepPurple, each with a cream scallop edge and a green dot at its base, like a rooster's tail on an alebrije. A small golden bead caps the fan's hub. The tail never touches the floor; its lowest point stays above the belly line.
parts.attaches: Roots into the tailRoot mount [0, 1.5, -1.5] at the torso's rump, buried slightly into the rump volume; rides the tail and tailTip joints.
